name: vivace-interview-portal
description: Vivace — AI multi-modal interview practice portal (Angular + Express + FastAPI + MongoDB + Gemini)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:ml && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
